name: Bush-hammered (struck with a toothed hammer over a sawn face)

roughness.source: Workings/bush-hammered.json: photograph ('an even, matt, pale, pitted face') and surface.arealRoughness (Sa 0.38 mm, rougher than the saw-cut 0.24 mm of Shading/Workings/sawn.json, roughness 0.8)
roughness.note: No gloss of a bush-hammered face was read: a first value above the sawn face's, as its craters leave no flat to reflect an image.

roughnessAcross.source: Workings/bush-hammered.json: the craters cover the whole face with no direction
roughnessAcross.derivation: a face with no grain: equal to the roughness along

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.source: Workings/bush-hammered.json: surface.arealRoughness (Sa 0.38 mm, measured on bush-hammered Travertino Amarillo; Molina et al. 2020, Table 2)
textureDepth.derivation: the areal roughness taken as the mean texture depth the face holds as a film, as for the sawn and honed faces

relief.source: Workings/bush-hammered.json: surface.arealRoughness (Sa 0.38 mm; its Sz, crater rim to pit, is 2.24 mm)
